about: The voice-over script. Each line starts `offset` seconds after its shot (`clip`, a name from CLIPS in edit/render.py) begins. A recording goes in assets/voiceover.(wav|mp3): one take of all the lines in order, with a short pause between them; sound.py splits it at the pauses.

lines.text: Article Studio starts with one topic.
It researches real sources, plans the piece, and writes a full draft in the brand's voice.
Then it briefs and paints a cover for the story.
One click publishes it to the Designally Knowledge Hub.
Article Studio. Designed and built by Khun Shine Si Thu.
